name: fishing
description: Fishing — a posture-based perpetual cast-and-wait action for water-adjacent zones. A bite arms the client tension-bar reel overlay (fishing_game); landing it pulls a catch from a reused scavenging loot table, gated by the Fishing skill. Rod required, bait optional; rare monster hooks spawn a live enemy, botched reels can snap the rod.

fish.note: KNOWN GAP: dual-gated — zone flag fishing_table_id (ambient, not examinable) + a carried item tagged fishing_rod. Not exposed as a rod specializedAction because the verb also needs a fishing zone; advertising `fish` on examine rod in a dry zone would mislead. Discovered via the rod item description / help.

fishresolve.note: KNOWN GAP: internal tension-bar overlay callback (token-gated); never typed by a player.
